scripts.db:schema: sh -c 'f=supabase/schema.sql; { echo "-- PingPod Morrisville Rewards — full schema, generated from supabase/migrations (in order)."; echo "-- For a brand-new project you can run this file once in the SQL editor."; echo "-- Source of truth: the numbered files in supabase/migrations.
